overall: The AG found the Board timely responded to the February 26 complaint, so no violation; the remote-participation allegation was withdrawn and not addressed. The AG reminded the Board of its duty to respond timely to complaints, but ordered no remedy.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to timely respond to his February 26 Open Meeting Law complaint, which he said alleged a February 18 violation.
allegations.key_passage: Because March 18 was the fourteenth business day following February 26, we find that the Board timely responded to the February 26 complaint.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to announce the name of each member who participated remotely at its March 18 meeting; the complainant later withdrew this part.
allegations.key_passage: In subsequent communications with our office, the Complainant withdrew this portion of the complaint, and we do not address it.
